I have no pdftoppm, no ImageMagick, no mutool. But I installed pypdf. pypdf has the ability to render PDFs? No, pypdf doesn't render. I need an image rendering tool.

Let me think about what's available. Options:
1. pip install pdf2image (needs poppler/pdftoppm binary)
2. pip install PyMuPDF (fitz) - this can render PDF to image without external dependencies! This is the best option.

Let me install PyMuPDF (fitz) which bundles its own rendering.
